description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kiribathkumbura, Yatinuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No.320552
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels, their owners, extents, and encumbrances in Kiribathkumbura village. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in Type 4 (Land Gazettes) classification criteria.
